      public boolean isValidSelection(int requestedUpper, int requestedLower, int characterCardsUpper, int characterCardsLower, int affordableBuildingsUpper, int affordableBuildingsLower)
      Validates if the tile action allows the selected draws.
      Parameters:
      requestedUpper - the requested draws from the upper row
      requestedLower - the requested draws from the lower row
      characterCardsUpper - the available character cards in the upper row
      characterCardsLower - the available character cards in the lower row
      affordableBuildingsUpper - the affordable buildings in the upper row
      affordableBuildingsLower - the affordable buildings in the lower row
      Returns:
      true if the selection is valid, false otherwise
